source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-year 2023 (current) / 2021 (growth) table-based summary files; ACS 1-year 2021-2023 for MSA/county trend; TIGER 2024 cartographic boundaries; FEMA National Risk Index; FRED (keyless CSV)

model.score: Weighted mean of 11 category scores. Each category is the mean of the percentile scores (0-10) of its member factors, computed within the geography level. Category weights are documented in categoryWeights; the captured app's own weights were never sent to the browser, so these are a stated approximation.
model.forecast: 3-year trend extrapolation: the observed 2021->2023 5-year change scaled by 1.5 and damped 0.6 for mean reversion, capped at the 5th/95th percentile of observed growth at the same level. Labelled 'trend' in the UI.

proxies.climate: FEMA National Risk Index (public) stands in for licensed First Street data
proxies.macro: FRED series (public, keyless) stand in for their server-side macro feed
proxies.safety: ACS poverty rate stands in for FBI crime counts
proxies.land_regulation: ACS median year built stands in for the Wharton WRLURI index
proxies.innovation: ACS information/professional sector shares stand in for LEHD LODES job buckets
